name: Hollowshade Moor
description: Hollowshade Moor is a volatile region where Owlbears, Sonic Wolves, and Grimlings battle for territorial dominance. The Warfront Basin serves as the central battlefield, while tribal territories, Vah Shir outposts, and dangerous wetlands surround it. Regional control shifts dynamically based on tribal victories, raids, and heroic interventions.
